post.quote: Trust isn't announced. It's accumulated, one kept promise at a time.
post.practice: Make one small promise today and keep it exactly. Reliable follow-through in small things is how people learn they can count on you in big ones.

caption:
Trust is built in small moments.

“Trust isn't announced. It's accumulated, one kept promise at a time.”

Try this today: Make one small promise today and keep it exactly. Reliable follow-through in small things is how people learn they can count on you in big ones.
